units.source_text: 时已入夜，主人朱雀院方面的人和客人六条院方面的上级官员，一同在朱雀院御前飨宴。

en.t: By then night had fallen, and the people of the host, the Suzaku院, together with the high officials from the guest's side, the Rokujoin, joined in a banquet before the Suzaku院.

units.source_text: 肴馔都是素食，虽无山珍海味，却也别有风味。

en.t: All the dishes were vegetarian; though there were no rare delicacies from mountain or sea, they had a charm all their own.

units.source_text: 朱雀院御前设一浅香木方几，几上陈列几个食缽，简单朴素，迥非昔比。

en.t: Before the Suzaku院 stood a square table of aloeswood, with several food bowls arranged on it, simple and plain, utterly unlike former days.

units.source_text: 诸人见此光景，无不感慨流泪。

en.t: Everyone who saw this scene was moved to tears.

units.source_text: 此外可哀之事甚多，为免烦冗，恕不尽述。

en.t: There were many other sorrowful things besides, but to avoid tedious detail, I will not recount them all.
Genji did not take his leave until late into the night.

units.source_text: 朱雀院犒赏随从人员种种物品，又派宫中长官大纳言护送源氏返邸。

en.t: The Suzaku院 rewarded the attendants with various gifts, and also sent the court chief, the Dainagon, to escort Genji back to his residence.

units.source_text: 今日天雪，气候严寒，主人朱雀院感冒加重，身体很不舒服。

en.t: That day it was snowing and bitterly cold, and the host, the Suzaku院, had a worsening cold and felt very unwell.

units.source_text: 但三公主终身大事已定，从此可以放心了。

en.t: But the Third Princess's lifelong future had now been settled, so from this point on he could be at ease.
